summary: Design workforce capability programmes with skills gap analysis, learning pathways, and measurable reporting. Enrol in 5-day training.
lede: Workforce learning programme design turns capability gaps into structured, role-based development. For HR, learning and development, talent, and workforce-planning professionals, it covers mapping skills to roles, shaping learning pathways, and choosing delivery methods, with practice in setting capability measures and reporting programme outcomes through scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, design, fund, or govern workforce capability programmes and need to turn skills gaps into structured learning pathways.
audience: People Analytics Specialists using skills data
prerequisites: Intermediate to advanced familiarity with workforce development, learning design, or talent management is recommended. You should have a working knowledge of training needs analysis, employee capability reviews, and basic reporting in spreadsheets; coding is not required. If your role involves skills data, learning pathways, or programme governance, you will benefit most from bringing a current or recent workforce capability challenge, a sample skills matrix, and a laptop for practical exercises. Advanced concepts such as AI-supported skills inference and learning analytics are covered at an operational application level, not at technical engineering depth.
